technique_name: Generate a paragraph describing the impact of climate change on family farms.
description: Climate change has had a devastating effect on family farms around the world. As temperatures rise, many crops become more susceptible to drought, and weather patterns become increasingly unpredictable. This can cause financial hardship, with losses in the millions of dollars per year, leading to the closure of many family-run farms.
